description: Headless SculptForge LOD/convert commands and the SculptForge Blender bridge handoff, with project-confined paths and artifact hashes; live GUI automation and arbitrary remote execution are not claimed.
requires: SculptForge Blender bridge add-on for bridge commands
checks: SculptForge CLI is located and --help succeeds for status
Blender bridge extension and exchange folder are inspected honestly
input/output paths resolve inside the project and reject script metacharacters
LOD output files exist for every requested level
convert output exists and is hashed
bridge send reports whether the exchange manifest changed
bridge receive fails honestly when no returned mesh exists
SculptForge is not redistributed by Gypsy
